definition.simple: When you put two or more different things together, but they don't chemically react. They are just mixed.
definition.academic: A substance consisting of two or more elements or compounds not chemically combined together.

common_misconceptions: A mixture creates a new substance. (Correction: No, the components retain their original properties.)
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask: If I mix sand and iron nails, can I separate them easily? (Yes, with a magnet). This means it's a mixture!
